# Frank AI Researcher

> Frank is an AI user researcher that runs short voice interviews. Frank AI Researcher (short name: Frank) interviews your own customers by voice, then turns the conversations into transcripts, themes and quotes. Built by Prelaunch.com.

Free plan: 60 voice minutes a month, no card required. MCP is included on every plan, including Free.

## Key pages
- [Pricing](https://www.hifrank.ai/pricing): plans, prices and billing rules
- [MCP connector](https://www.hifrank.ai/mcp): connect Frank to ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Muse
- [Voice interviewer](https://www.hifrank.ai/ai-voice-interviewer): how voice interviews work
- [Docs](https://www.hifrank.ai/docs): guides, including the [MCP connector setup](https://www.hifrank.ai/docs/frank-mcp-connector)
- [Security](https://www.hifrank.ai/features/transparency-security): SOC 2 and GDPR compliant
